trans.sense: either of two small woodpeckers, Jynx torquilla and Jynx ruficollis

glosses: Either of two small woodpeckers, Jynx torquilla and Jynx ruficollis, of the Old World, that turn their heads almost 180 degrees when foraging.

raw_glosses: (medicine, dated) A twisted or distorted neck; a deformity in which the neck is drawn to one side by a rigid contraction of one of the muscles.
